title: Buyback of Government of India Dated Securities
description: The Government of India has announced the buyback of its Securities through auction for an aggregate amount of ₹20,000 crore (face value). The security-wise details of the buyback are as under: S.No. Security Date of Maturity 1. 7.33% GS 2026 October 30, 2026 2. 5.74% GS 2026 November 15, 2026 3. 8.15% GS 2026 November 24, 2026 4. 8.24% GS 2027 February 15, 2027 There is no notified amount for the individual securities within the aggregate ceiling of ₹20,000 crore.
